versions.name: American Cultures
versions.description: Meet three groups whose background differs from your own — by race, ethnicity, or faith — through a festival, a place of worship, or a museum, then compare their customs and contributions before leading a discussion.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
